text:
Given the triad of a benign-appearing ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion with a normal CA-125, this presentation is highly suggestive of Meigs' syndrome. I need to confirm the mass is likely a fibroma and rule out other malignancies.

REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis. REQUEST TEST: Thoracentesis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CT and thoracentesis results, combined with the classic triad of an ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion, strongly support a diagnosis of Meigs' syndrome, likely due to an ovarian fibroma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Meigs' syndrome
